Certificate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Material Handling Plant — Jharkhand Pkg-12” (industrial epc),
awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has
been completed in all respects on July 27, 2020 at a gross executed value of INR 73,02,00,000/-
(Rupees 73.02 Crore Only).
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and
contract conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried
out by the undersigned.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Imran Joshi. This certificate is issued for record
and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
performance.
Executive Engineer
Jal Nigam, Jharkhand
